# Tinderbox compact train controls

Original files are byte-preserved from Tinderbox commit fb0628605c274550ff8abad50b151843f08747d1.
Source code, guide and evidence remain references; Nautilus adaptations are in
packages/train-ui. No donor worktree is changed. The user authorized this reuse;
no general source-project license is inferred. Existing source metadata and
Farmyard wood ancestry are preserved.

Besley and Old Standard TT are unmodified fonts under SIL Open Font License 1.1.
Their original copyright and complete terms are retained in:

- assets/art/ui/typography/besley/OFL.txt
- assets/art/ui/typography/oldstandardtt/OFL.txt

Font source commits and hashes are in assets/art/ui/typography/manifest.json.
The exact imported file inventory and resource hashes are in source.json.
